# Sentinel Finance

> Open-source, self-hosted web app for real-time stock news sentiment analysis. Fetches latest news for any US stock via Finnhub, scores each article from -1 (bearish) to +1 (bullish) with FinBERT or a DeBERTa-v3 NLI model, and streams results to a React UI as NDJSON. MIT licensed. University project, Web Information Retrieval course, University of Genoa (UniGE).

Key facts:

- Search by ticker (AAPL), company name (Apple) or natural-language theme (optional Gemini LLM).
- FinBERT score = P(positive) - P(negative). NLI score = P(entail "stock will go up") - P(entail "stock will go down"). Ticker score = mean of article scores.
- Stock detail view: OHLC price chart with news event pins, scored article list, optional LLM insight card, competitors.
- Watchlists with sentiment-change notifications. Background prefetch of S&P 500 and trending tickers into Redis.
- Stack: React 19 + Vite (webclient), Node.js 22 + Express 5 + Drizzle ORM (core), Python 3.12 + Transformers + PyTorch (analyzer), PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ priority queue.
- Contract-first: OpenAPI 3 (REST), AsyncAPI 2 (RabbitMQ), JSON Schema; TypeScript types generated by CI.
- Install: set FINNHUB_API_KEY in .env, run `docker compose up --build`, open http://localhost:3000.
